title: Night Out Venue
description: Hosted social evening at a named venue
useWhen: Archy hosts at a named venue and there is a good photo of it.
notWhen: there is no venue photo (use `Night Out Illustration`).
guidance: Dates follow the house style: "March 12 – 14, 2026". Kickers and event names in title case (the design sets uppercase where needed).
Images (city or venue photo, speaker portrait) and partner logos: an https link from the requester, or an approved asset. Never generate a person or a venue; a city photo may be left out.
Leave out any fact that does not exist (booth, venue, time): its label goes with it and the layout closes up.
